The '''Trancret Stock Exchange Swindle''' was a criminal fraud perpetrated on [[Trancret]] by the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Janstren Brell]] and his [[Red & Black League]]. It was a large swindle that netted Brell the interest of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] on crimes of conspiracy and fraud.
